people.name: Elam
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel

translations.web: ‘But it will happen in the latter days that I will reverse the captivity of Elam,’ says Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: “Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring back the captivity of Elam, saith Jehovah.
